svg.text: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash · KLD by category, v1.0 → v2.0
KLD vs the original checkpoint, to first EOS (lower is better) · 2 prompts × 512 tokens per category · top-1 agreement beside each bar
Each Sushi bar moves in turn from the v1.0 pack to the v2.0 pack; the oQ2.5e bars stay put as the reference.
Teacher: the original FP8/FP4 checkpoint run by sushi with no lossy step (full-width KV, DSpark off). Solid bar = lower KLD in that category.
Sushi STQ 1.75bpw: 332.1 GB on disk; v2.0 scored on sushi 1.5.0. oQ2.5e (mlx-community): 342.7 GB, its logits taken through mlx-serve's DeepSeek path.
